contract.question: Does answer-only search select a configuration that stores unwanted facts or fails independent audit cases?
contract.selection: Maximize development exact-answer scenario success; break ties in declared candidate order. No audit feedback enters selection.
contract.primary_metric: Fraction of scenarios with every query answer exactly correct
contract.state_requirement: No write labeled should_retain=false may change memory state
contract.exposure: Original synthetic fixtures authored with knowledge of the candidates. Audit cases are withheld from the selector, not blind to the authors; after export all cases are public.
contract.statistics: Paired bootstrap resamples audit scenarios, not deterministic repeats. Intervals describe this constructed case mix; they do not establish population generalization or correct for candidate selection.
contract.budget: Eight fixed configurations; five fresh-state sweeps each; zero provider calls. No adaptive candidate generation or live LLM exploit discovery.
contract.adoption: Local eligibility demonstration only; no deployment or production approval.
